_readme: Template. Project-specific. Defines what this project treats as CORE / RELEVANT / CONDITIONAL / IRRELEVANT / UNKNOWN. Keyword business eligibility (YES/NO/UNKNOWN) is decided against this file. Anything CONDITIONAL or UNKNOWN needs a CLIENT-CONFIRMATION-QUEUE.csv entry.

irrelevant.notes: Only what is explicitly unsupported or out of the target market. DIY, jobs, informational, product, comparison, branded intents are listed here ONLY if this project actually excludes them.

intent_notes: How each intent class is valued for THIS business (from the profile).
